doe_main_effects — MULTIVAR analysis op

• 数据种类:design × signal → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.doe_main_effects(design=None, y=None, goal='larger') -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import multivar; multivar.doe_main_effects(design=None, y=None, goal='larger') -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsmultivar.get("doe_main_effects"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

各因子的水平均值（设计实验的响应表），附离散度与 SN 比。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

y is (n,) or (n, r) with r repeated measurements (or noise-array conditions) per run. For each factor and level: the mean of y (location), the mean of log s over the runs at that level (dispersion, needs r >= 2), the main-effect range (max - min of the level means) and its share of the total sum of squares.

SN ratios are computed per run (Taguchi): larger-the-better -10 log10(mean(1/y^2)) (the same formula as spc.spc_mt_sn_ratio, reused), smaller-the-better -10 log10(mean(y^2)), nominal-the-best 10 log10(ybar^2/s^2), and their level means are reported in sn. They are not the basis of the recommended levels: an SN ratio mixes location and dispersion in one number, and a level can raise it by lowering the mean (Box 1988; Nair 1992). best_levels chooses from the location table by goal ("larger", "smaller", or "nominal" — which picks the levels of smallest dispersion and leaves the mean to an adjustment factor), and sn_agrees says where the SN table would have chosen differently.
